_purpose: EXPLORATORY, a classical population model, no quantum content. Stage E of docs/theory/observer_relative_histories_research_handoff.md: the observer-moment rate W(t) over cosmic time in one fixed Planck-2018 background, built from Loeb, Batista and Sloan 2016 Eqs. (2.1) to (2.4) with the Madau-Dickinson 2014 Eq. (15) star-formation history, plus the declared synthetic knobs of src/orh/cosmic.py (evolutionary delay, observer lifetime, reference class, interaction factor, exotic late observers). The scenario grid and the analysis choices below were written on 2026-10-12 before the script was run (docs/theory/orh_implementation_plan.md, Stage E). F(13.8 Gyr) is reported, never used as evidence for a measure (Hartle and Srednicki 2007, Eq. 4.2).
